title: 17 瘴气平原18 上古遗迹19 夺舍
content_zh:
半小时后，洛豪就来到了瘴气平原，经过几十秒的神识探寻，洛豪知道了瘴气平原的入口。来到瘴气平原的入口，洛豪就看到瘴气平原入口有一个石碑，石碑上写着一些信息:此处为横断山脉危险禁地，修为不到聚婴期，最好不要进入，否则后果自负。
洛豪服下了一株瘴灵花，然后走进了入口。
进入了入口，眼前的情景忽然变了，白雾蒙蒙的一片，灰蒙蒙的空间什么东西也没有，与在入口外面看到的瘴气笼罩的情景截然不同。
洛豪不用多想也知道自己进入了一个阵法，难怪瘴气平原的瘴气不会扩散出去，原来有人用阵法将瘴气给阻拦住了，这是一个幻阵，具体等级洛豪还不清楚，但是洛豪也知道要想进入瘴气平原就必须破掉这个阵法。
洛豪知道无论在阵法当中如何的走动，都只会是像踏入没有出口的迷宫一般永远也走不出去，所以洛豪索性就找了一个地方坐了下来，开始推演这个阵法。
阵法如果等级比较低，自己的实力远远强于阵法等级，那还可以选择强硬攻击将阵法给强行打破，但是洛豪不说修为不高，就是这个阵法的等级也比较高。
洛豪估计这是一个二级甚至有可能是三级的幻阵，二级的幻阵就是成丹期的修士也不一定能够打开，何况洛豪才结真初期巅峰修为。
洛豪知道，这是一个很好的机会，洛豪相信凭借混沌万物决，他可以摸索出这个幻阵的奥秘之处，甚至还能够学会布阵。
洛豪闭上了双眼，双手不停的打出手势，就像是在练太极一般，手势越来越快，几个呼吸之后，洛豪就从混沌书中拿出了一些炼器用的材料，然后使用真火将炼器材料炼制成了阵旗。
但这并不是结束，洛豪要推演出这个幻阵的阵基，才能够将阵旗放置到正确的位置，从而破掉这个幻阵，当然洛豪也并没有打算破掉这个幻阵，而是想着制造一个出口。
洛豪的周身似乎被一阵玄奥的气息所围绕，如果有修士在这里看到洛豪的样子，绝对会大吃一惊。
因为洛豪这是陷入了顿悟，这一个顿悟就不知道是多长时间，但不管顿悟多久，即便最终不能够破掉这个幻阵，也会学到一些布阵的手法。
半天的时间一晃而过，洛豪终于睁开了眼睛，然后长啸一声，将手中的四枚阵旗分别从东西南北四个不同的方向扔了出去，当四枚阵旗恰好落在了四个方向的绝佳位置上之后，洛豪已经明白，自己真的已经破掉了这个幻阵。
这是一个二级巅峰的幻阵，只差一点点就到三级了，主要还是布置这个幻阵的资源不够，洛豪推测出来布置这个幻阵用了上千枚中品灵石，但洛豪并没有想要这个幻阵的灵石资源。
因为一旦幻阵被打破，那么瘴气就会阻拦不住，从而扩散出去，那对横断山下所有的修士都是一个巨大的灾难。
而洛豪刚刚扔了四枚阵旗，主要是为了制造一个出口，而这个出口已经被洛豪给打开，洛豪只要挥动手中剩余的一枚阵旗，就可以从这个幻阵中出去。
同时洛豪也明白了如果再加一枚上品灵石或者一千枚中品灵石，这个幻阵就可以突破成为三级。
但洛豪并没有这么做，半天的时间使得洛豪成为了一个二级阵法师，也就是说洛豪现在可以轻易的布置出一个二级幻阵。
可惜的是没有阵法玉简，如果有阵法玉简，那么洛豪还可以根据这个幻阵来推演出防御阵法，困杀阵法，甚至传送阵都能够布置出来。
不同阵法的布置方式是不同的，除非能够亲自推演另一种阵法，否则即便混沌万物决再强大，也不能够让洛豪推演出其它阵法的布置方式。

但洛豪相信，现在就算有人布置二级的阵法，让他感受一下阵法的布置方式，他都能很快破掉这个阵法。
出了这个幻阵，前方赫然是一片平原，只是可惜的时候，平原被瘴气给笼罩，洛豪一进入瘴气平原，就感受到了一阵不适，不少瘴气已经侵入了他的经脉，洛豪肯定如果不是自己吞服了瘴灵花，这瘴气绝对会将自己置于死地。
就算自己吞服了瘴灵花，身体都是一阵阵的不适，之前在雾湿地的雾气都没能冲破他的黑蛛刀所制造的光圈，结果这瘴气轻而易举就突破了他的刀圈，进入了他的经脉，这瘴气跟之前的雾气简直是天壤之别。
瘴气进入了洛豪的经脉，甚至还发出了一些摩擦声，然后隔了几个呼吸被瘴灵花给中和掉了之后，洛豪才没有感觉到不适。
洛豪肯定，这瘴气甚至可以轻易的杀死一个凝元期的修士。
好在洛豪的瘴灵花还比较多，再次吞服了一株瘴灵花，洛豪才继续在瘴气中行走。
从中年男修士的地图玉简中，洛豪知道瘴气平原中有一处上古遗迹。
遗迹中有什么，地图上没有介绍，但好东西肯定是不少的。
按照地图玉简指示的路线，不过半天时间，洛豪就来到了上古遗迹的入口，这里已经算是瘴气平原的深处了。
洛豪的神识释放开来，却发现神识探测的距离很近，只有五百米远，范围被缩短了四分之一，洛豪也没有办法，除非洛豪的实力提升上去了。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Luo Hao arrived at the Miasma Plain. After dozens of seconds of spiritual exploration, Luo Hao knew the entrance to the Miasma Plain. Arriving at the entrance of the Miasma Plain, Luo Hao saw a stone tablet at the entrance of the Miasma Plain. There was some information written on the stone tablet: This is a dangerous and forbidden area in the Hengduan Mountains. If you have not cultivated to the infant gathering stage, it is best not to enter, otherwise you will be responsible for the consequences.
Luo Hao drank a miasma flower and walked into the entrance.
Entering the entrance, the scene in front of me suddenly changed. There was a white mist, and there was nothing in the gray space. It was completely different from the miasma-shrouded scene seen outside the entrance.
Luo Hao didn't need to think too much to know that he had entered a formation. No wonder the miasma in the Miasma Plain would not spread out. It turned out that someone had used a formation to block the miasma. This was a phantom formation. Luo Hao didn't know the specific level, but Luo Hao also knew that he had to break this formation if he wanted to enter the Miasma Plain.
Luo Hao knew that no matter how he moved around in the formation, it would be like stepping into a maze with no exit and never getting out, so Luo Hao simply found a place to sit down and began to deduce the formation.
If the level of the formation is relatively low and your strength is far stronger than the level of the formation, you can also choose to attack hard to break the formation. However, not to mention Luo Hao's low cultivation level, even the level of this formation is relatively high.
Luo Hao estimated that this was a second-level or even third-level phantom formation. Even monks in the alchemy stage might not be able to open the second-level phantom formation, not to mention that Luo Hao was only at the peak of his early cultivation level.
Luo Hao knew that this was a good opportunity. Luo Hao believed that with the Chaos All Thing Art, he could figure out the mystery of this illusion formation and even learn how to set it up.
Luo Hao closed his eyes and kept making gestures with his hands, as if practicing Tai Chi. The gestures became faster and faster. After a few breaths, Luo Hao took out some weapon refining materials from the book of chaos, and then used real fire to refine the weapon refining materials into a formation flag.
But this is not the end. Luo Hao has to deduce the base of this phantom formation before he can place the formation flag in the correct position to break this phantom formation. Of course, Luo Hao does not intend to break this phantom formation, but wants to create an exit.
Luo Hao's whole body seemed to be surrounded by a mysterious aura. If any monk saw Luo Hao's appearance here, he would definitely be shocked.
This is because Luo Hao has fallen into an epiphany. I don’t know how long this epiphany lasts, but no matter how long it lasts, even if he cannot break the illusory formation in the end, he will still learn some techniques for setting up the formation.
Half a day passed by in a flash. Luo Hao finally opened his eyes. Then he let out a long roar and threw the four formation flags in his hands from four different directions: east, west, north and south. When the four formation flags happened to land in perfect positions in the four directions, Luo Hao already understood that he had really broken the illusory formation.
This is a second-level peak phantom formation, just shy of reaching the third level. The main reason is that there are not enough resources to set up this phantom formation. Luo Hao speculated that it took thousands of middle-grade spiritual stones to set up this phantom formation, but Luo Hao did not want the spiritual stone resources for this phantom formation.
Because once the illusion formation is broken, the miasma will be unable to stop it and spread out, which will be a huge disaster for all the monks under Hengduan Mountain.
Luo Hao just threw four formation flags, mainly to create an exit, and this exit has been opened by Luo Hao. Luo Hao can get out of this illusory formation by waving the remaining formation flag in his hand.
At the same time, Luo Hao also understood that if one more high-grade spiritual stone or a thousand medium-grade spiritual stones were added, this illusion array could break through to level three.
But Luo Hao didn't do this. In half a day, Luo Hao became a second-level array mage, which meant that Luo Hao could now easily set up a second-level magic array.
It's a pity that there is no arrayFa Jade Slips, if there are formation jade slips, then Luo Hao can also deduce defensive formations, trapping formations, and even teleportation formations based on this phantom formation.
The layout of different formations is different. Unless he can personally deduce another formation, no matter how powerful the Chaos Everything Art is, Luo Hao will not be able to deduce the layout of other formations.
But Luo Hao believes that even if someone arranges a second-level formation and lets him feel how the formation is arranged, he can quickly break it.
After leaving this illusion formation, there was a plain ahead. Unfortunately, the plain was shrouded in miasma. As soon as Luo Hao entered the miasma plain, he felt a sense of discomfort. A lot of miasma had invaded his meridians. Luo Hao was sure that if he had not swallowed the miasma spirit flower, this miasma would definitely kill him.
Even if he swallowed the Miasma Spirit Flower, his body would feel uncomfortable in waves. The mist in the fog wetland could not break through the aperture created by his black spider knife. As a result, the miasma easily broke through the circle of his knife and entered his meridians. This miasma was completely different from the previous mist.
The miasma entered Luo Hao's meridians and even made some friction sounds. After a few breaths, it was neutralized by the Miasma Spirit Flower, and Luo Hao didn't feel any discomfort.
Luo Hao was sure that this miasma could even easily kill a monk at the Condensation Stage.
Fortunately, Luo Hao still had more miasma spirit flowers. After swallowing one miasma spirit flower again, Luo Hao continued to walk in the miasma.
From the map slips of the middle-aged male monk, Luo Hao knew that there was an ancient ruins in the Miasma Plain.
What is in the ruins is not introduced on the map, but there must be a lot of good things.
Following the route indicated by the jade slip on the map, Luo Hao arrived at the entrance of the ancient ruins in just half a day, which was already considered the depths of the Miasma Plain.
Luo Hao released his spiritual consciousness, but found that the detection distance of his spiritual consciousness was very close, only 500 meters away, and the range was shortened by a quarter. Luo Hao had nothing to do unless Luo Hao's strength improved.
